name: Roslyn
desc: Open-source compilers and code analysis APIs for C# and VB.NET languages.

resources.name: Roslyn Succinctly
resources.desc: *Free e-book* by Alessandro Del Sole and the perfect book to start with. Explains Roslyn APIs and afterward focuses on writing analyzers and refactorings.

resources.name: .NET Development Using the Compiler API
resources.desc: Book by Jason Bock. Besides analyzers and refactorings, it also explains the scripting API and provides an interesting reflection on the future of the Compiler API.

resources.name: Roslyn Cookbook
resources.desc: Book by Manish Vasani, a member of the Roslyn analyzers team. After covering analyzers, refactorings, and scripting in detail, the book goes in-depth explaining how to develop new C# language features and contribute to the Roslyn source code.

resources.name: Learn Roslyn Now
resources.desc: Series of blog posts that explore the Roslyn compiler API. It introduces the power of Roslyn through small self-contained examples. A perfect tutorial to start with :-)

resources.name: How To Write a C# Analyzer and Code Fix
resources.desc: The mother of all Roslyn tutorials :-) A realistic step-by-step introduction to syntax and semantic analysis as well as the syntax transformation.

resources.name: C# and Visual Basic - Use Roslyn to Write a Live Code Analyzer for Your API
resources.desc: Older but still not outdated, very detailed MSDN article on writing code analyzers.

resources.name: C# - Adding a Code Fix to Your Roslyn Analyzer
resources.desc: The sequel to the previous MSDN article. A detailed introduction into code fixes.

resources.name: Introducing C# Source Generators
resources.desc: Original announcement of the C# 9.0 Source Generators feature. Explains what source generators are, in which scenarios they are useful, and shows how to write a simple source generator.

resources.name: New C# Source Generator Samples
resources.desc: Samples on how to write a non-trivial code generator driven by additional, non-code files like CSV files or Mustache templates.

resources.name: C# Source Generators
resources.desc: Comprehensive list of additional learning sources, samples, and experimental and productive source generators. A perfect reference once you grasp the basics.

resources.name: Bridge
resources.desc: C# to JavaScript transpiler. Write modern mobile and web apps in C# and run them anywhere in JavaScript.

resources.name: Code Converter
resources.desc: C# to VB.NET and VB.NET to C# transpiler.

resources.name: CodeAnalysis.CSharp.PatternMatching
resources.desc: Intuitive pattern matching for Roslyn syntax trees. Simplifies C# syntax and semantic analysis.

resources.name: CodeGeneration.Roslyn
resources.desc: Roslyn-based Code Generation during a build with design-time support.

resources.name: dotnet-script
resources.desc: Runs C# scripts from the .NET CLI, defines NuGet packages inline and edit/debugs them in VS Code.

resources.name: FlubuCore
resources.desc: Cross platform build automation tool for building projects and executing deployment scripts using C# code.

resources.name: MirrorSharp
resources.desc: Online C#, VB.NET, and F# code editor. Features code completion, method signature help, quick fixes, and diagnostics.

resources.name: OmniSharp
resources.desc: Enables a cross platform .NET development in the editor of your choice. A family of open source projects, each with one goal: To enable a great .NET experience in your editor of choice.

resources.name: roslyn-linq-rewrite
resources.desc: Compiles C# code by first rewriting the syntax trees of LINQ expressions using plain procedural code. This increases performance by minimizes heap allocations and dynamic dispatch.

resources.name: RoslynPad
resources.desc: Cross-platform C# editor. Features code completion, method signature help, quick fixes, and diagnostics.

resources.name: RoslynQuoter
resources.desc: Online tool that for a given C# program generates syntax tree API calls that construct syntax tree of that program.

resources.name: scriptcs
resources.desc: Turns C# into a powerful scripting tool. Features C# REPL, installation of NuGet packages, and execution of scripts with a single line of code.

resources.name: Scripty
resources.desc: Tool to use Roslyn-powered C# scripts for code generation. You can think of it as a scripted alternative to T4 templates.

resources.name: Sharpen
resources.desc: Visual Studio extension that intelligently introduces new C# language features into your existing code base.

resources.name: SharpLab
resources.desc: .NET code playground. Displays intermediate steps and results of code compilation. Shows the code as compiler sees it. Allows selecting different branches and versions of Roslyn. Runs C#, VB.NET, and F# code in the browser.

resources.name: Testura.Code
resources.desc: Wrapper around the Roslyn API used for generation, saving, and compiling C# code. Provides methods and helpers to generate classes, methods, statements, and expressions.

resources.name: Uno SourceGenerator
resources.desc: C# source code generator based on a project being built, using all of its syntactic and semantic model information.

resources.name: .NET Analyzers
resources.desc: GitHub organization for the development of Roslyn analyzers. Various repositories within the organization cover analyzers for ASP.NET Core, WPF, IDisposable, usages of System.Reflection, etc.
resources.section: Open Source Analyzers, Code Fixes, and Refactorings

resources.name: .NET Compiler Platform ("Roslyn") Analyzers
resources.desc: Diagnostic analyzers developed by the Roslyn team. Initially developed to help flesh out the design and implementation of the static analysis APIs. The analyzers cover code quality, .NET Core, desktop .NET Framework, comments in code, and more.
resources.section: Open Source Analyzers, Code Fixes, and Refactorings

resources.name: Code Cracker
resources.desc: Analyzer library for C# and VB.NET. Offers diagnostics in many categories like performance, coding styles, as well as some basic refactorings.
resources.section: Open Source Analyzers, Code Fixes, and Refactorings

resources.name: CSharpGuidelinesAnalyzer
resources.desc: Reports diagnostics for C# coding guidelines (https://csharpcodingguidelines.com/).
resources.section: Open Source Analyzers, Code Fixes, and Refactorings

resources.name: ErrorProne.NET
resources.desc: Set of analyzers and code fixes focusing on the correctness and performance of C# programs. Inspired with Google's Error Prone.
resources.section: Open Source Analyzers, Code Fixes, and Refactorings

resources.name: Mapping Generator
resources.desc: Code fix that generates arbitrary complex object-object mappings. It recognizes out of the box a large number of scenarios where mappings are used. A design-time alternative to AutoMapper.
resources.section: Open Source Analyzers, Code Fixes, and Refactorings

resources.name: Nullable.Extended
resources.desc: Roslyn tools and analyzers to improve the experience when coding with nullable reference types.
resources.section: Open Source Analyzers, Code Fixes, and Refactorings

resources.name: Refactoring Essentials for Visual Studio
resources.desc: Refactorings, analyzers and code fixes for C# and VB.NET.
resources.section: Open Source Analyzers, Code Fixes, and Refactorings

resources.name: Roslyn Clr Heap Allocation Analyzer
resources.desc: C# heap allocation analyzer that can detect explicit and many implicit allocations like boxing, closures, implicit delegate creations, etc.
resources.section: Open Source Analyzers, Code Fixes, and Refactorings

resources.name: Roslynator
resources.desc: Collection of 190+ analyzers and 190+ refactorings for C#. Covers coding style, code readability and simplification, removing redundancies, fixing compiler errors, and many more.
resources.section: Open Source Analyzers, Code Fixes, and Refactorings

resources.name: SonarC#
resources.desc: Static code analyzer for C# language used as an extension for the SonarQube platform.
resources.section: Open Source Analyzers, Code Fixes, and Refactorings

resources.name: StyleCop Analyzers for the .NET Compiler Platform
resources.desc: Port of StyleCop rules to Roslyn.
resources.section: Open Source Analyzers, Code Fixes, and Refactorings

resources.name: VSDiagnostics
resources.desc: Collection of code-quality analyzers. Covers usages of async methods, flags enums, best practices in exception handling as well as many other code-quality checks.
resources.section: Open Source Analyzers, Code Fixes, and Refactorings

resources.name: Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing
resources.desc: Library for testing analyzers and code fixes with NUnit, xUnit and MSTest frameworks. A part of Roslyn SDK.
resources.section: Libraries and Frameworks for Testing Analyzers, Code Fixes, and Refactorings

resources.name: RoslynTestKit
resources.desc: Lightweight framework for writing unit tests for analyzers, code fixes, refactorings, and completion providers. It's unit testing framework agnostic.
resources.section: Libraries and Frameworks for Testing Analyzers, Code Fixes, and Refactorings

resources.name: DpDtInject
resources.desc: Proof-of-concept of a dependency injection container that transfers huge piece of resolving logic to the compilation stage. Offers additional compile-time safety and fast runtime resolution.

resources.name: Generator.Equals
resources.desc: Automatically implements equality and hashing for classes and records. Supports different comparison strategies. Offers similar functionality like IL weaving-based Equals.Fody.

resources.name: JsonSrcGen
resources.desc: Reflection-free JSON serializer. Allows extremely fast JSON processing by generating reflection-free serializers at the compile time.

resources.name: Source Generator Playground
resources.desc: Online application that lets you experiment with source generators. Perfect for learning and testing your ideas. Write your own source generator or learn from built-in examples and see the generated output.

resources.name: StrongInject
resources.desc: Compile-time dependency injection container. Compile-time checked, reflection-free and runtime code generation free, thus fast and app-trimming-friendly.

resources.name: StructPacker
resources.desc: Low-level, lightweight and performance-focused serializer for C# struct types. Auto-generates C# serialization code to achieve peak runtime performance and efficiency.

resources.name: Svg to C# Source Generators
resources.desc: SVG to C# compiler. Compiles SVG drawing markup to C# using SkiaSharp as rendering engine.

resources.name: WrapperValueObject
resources.desc: Creates boilerplate free wrappers around types. Especially useful for creating strongly typed wrappers around primitive types.

resources.name: How Microsoft rewrote its C# compiler in C# and made it open source
resources.desc: Roslyn's journey, presented by Mads Torgersen, the lead designer of C#. Inspiring story on how Roslyn project started and why, and what it took to make it open source.

resources.name: Inside the .NET Compiler Platform – Performance Considerations during Syntax Analysis (#SpeakRoslyn)
resources.desc: In-depth look at Roslyn's performance with the focus on memory consumption.

resources.name: Persistence, Facades and Roslyn's Red-Green Trees
resources.desc: Inspiring introduction on how Roslyn team implemented immutable, reusable trees with cheap parent references and many other goodies. Quote: "But on the Roslyn team we routinely do impossible things" :-)

resources.name: ReSharper and Roslyn: Q&A
resources.desc: Excellent explanation why ReSharper will not use Roslyn. Includes good discussion on static code analysis and some limits of Roslyn.

resources.name: Roslyn performance (Matt Gertz)
resources.desc: Insight on how Roslyn team approaches the topic of evaluating and achieving performance.

resources.name: The Power of Roslyn
resources.desc: Great talk by Kasey Uhlenhuth at NDC Oslo 2018 covering Roslyn essentials and APIs and tools for building code analyzers and fixes.
